description: List the batches in your workspace, newest first. A batch runs several saved tests against the same number together. Each has an id, name, description and `members`: each a type (param for a standard test, mission for a mission test) and its configId, in run order (testConfigIds repeats the standard ones). Also missionMembersEnabled for the workspace. Takes optional `limit` and `cursor` (nextCursor from the previous page; absent on the last page). Use when: the user asks what batches exist or names one. Name a member with getTestConfig or getMissionTestConfig. For a batch's runs use listBatchRuns. Read-only. Needs testing:read.

cursor.description:
Opaque base64 pagination cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`.
Omit for the first page.

name: listBatches

items.description:
A batch runs many `TestConfig`s against a single phone number / persona — useful
for end-to-end regression of a number's full call-flow coverage.

members.description:
Every member of the batch, typed, in dispatch order. Always present in responses;
batches created before typed membership existed read as all-`param` members.

items.description:
One member of a batch. `param` is a step-based voice test (`TestConfig`); `mission`
is an AI voice mission test (`MissionTestConfig`). The two live in different id
spaces, so the same `configId` may appear once as each type.

testConfigIds.description:
The batch's param (step-based) member ids, in member order. Always present and
always equal to the `param` entries of `members`; empty for a batch whose members
are all mission tests. Kept for clients that predate `members`.

missionMembersEnabled.description:
Whether this workspace can run batches that contain mission members.
Mission tests in batches are enabled one workspace at a time. When
false, a batch with a mission member can still be saved but running it
returns 400 `BATCH_MISSION_DISPATCH_UNAVAILABLE`.

title: List Test Batches
